introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure university VPN and remote-access management system that allows students, faculty, researchers, and administrative staff to securely access approved campus resources from off-campus locations.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should use centralized authentication, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication for privileged users, encrypted remote connections, session monitoring, and automatic security alerts.

items.title: Out of scope: stakeholder exclusion
items.detail: Sensitive administrative and research systems should only be accessible to specifically authorized users, while guest users must not receive VPN access.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: Network administrators should be able to create and revoke remote-access permissions, review active sessions, terminate suspicious sessions, manage VPN policies, and inspect audit logs.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-005
items.detail: The system should also detect repeated failed login attempts, unusual login locations, excessive session duration, and unauthorized attempts to access restricted internal resources.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-006
items.detail: All authentication events, access decisions, policy changes, and administrator actions must be logged.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-007
items.detail: The solution should be secure, scalable, reliable, and support both university-managed and approved personal devices.

functional.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: allow students, faculty, researchers, and administrative staff to securely access approved campus resources from off-campus locations.
requirements.statement: The system shall allow students, faculty, researchers, and administrative staff to securely access approved campus resources from off-campus locations.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated user attempting remote access
acceptance_criteria.when: The user connects via the university VPN
acceptance_criteria.then: The connection is established with encrypted tunneling and validated credentials
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of successful remote access session

unresolved_decisions: Which specific campus resources are approved for off-campus access

requirements.title: use centralized authentication, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication for privileged users, encrypted remote connections, session monitoring, and automatic security alerts.
requirements.statement: The system shall use centralized authentication, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication for privileged users, encrypted remote connections, session monitoring, and automatic security alerts.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with elevated privileges attempting to access a restricted resource
acceptance_criteria.when: The user performs an action requiring MFA verification
acceptance_criteria.then: The system prompts for multi-factor authentication and grants access only after successful completion
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of MFA prompt and successful access flow

unresolved_decisions: How role-based access is defined and updated

requirements.title: Sensitive administrative and research systems shall be accessible only to specifically authorized users, while guest users must not receive VPN access.
requirements.statement: Sensitive administrative and research systems shall be accessible only to specifically authorized users, while guest users must not receive VPN access.

acceptance_criteria.given: A guest user attempting to connect via the university VPN
acceptance_criteria.when: The system evaluates the user's authorization status
acceptance_criteria.then: The connection is denied with a clear message indicating unauthorized access
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of denial response for guest user

unresolved_decisions: How 'specifically authorized' users are identified and maintained

requirements.title: Network administrators shall be able to create and revoke remote-access permissions, review active sessions, terminate suspicious sessions, manage VPN policies, and inspect audit logs.
requirements.statement: Network administrators shall be able to create and revoke remote-access permissions, review active sessions, terminate suspicious sessions, manage VPN policies, and inspect audit logs.

acceptance_criteria.when: The administrator initiates a session termination for a suspicious connection
acceptance_criteria.then: The system terminates the session and updates the audit log with a timestamp and reason
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of session termination event in audit log

requirements.title: detect repeated failed login attempts, unusual login locations, excessive session duration, and unauthorized attempts to access restricted internal resources.
requirements.statement: The system shall detect repeated failed login attempts, unusual login locations, excessive session duration, and unauthorized attempts to access restricted internal resources.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user attempting multiple failed logins from a new location
acceptance_criteria.when: The system monitors the login pattern and triggers an alert
acceptance_criteria.then: An automated security alert is generated and sent to the appropriate team
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of failed login sequence and subsequent alert trigger

unresolved_decisions: What constitutes 'excessive' session duration or 'unusual' location

nonfunctional.applicability_reason: Existing canonical requirements, where applicable, are linked below; this section adds no separate obligation. Unresolved stakeholder decisions remain open.

security.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: All authentication events, access decisions, policy changes, and administrator actions must be logged.
requirements.statement: All authentication events, access decisions, policy changes, and administrator actions must be logged.

acceptance_criteria.given: An authenticated user performs a login or access decision
acceptance_criteria.when: The system records the event in an audit log
acceptance_criteria.then: The event is stored with timestamp, user ID, action type, and outcome
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the audit log entry

acceptance_criteria.given: A network administrator modifies a policy or revokes access rights
acceptance_criteria.when: The change is processed by the system
acceptance_criteria.then: The change is recorded in an audit log with metadata including actor, timestamp, and scope
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Manual inspection of the audit log for policy modification records

unresolved_decisions: What specific fields are required in each logged event?
How frequently should logs be retained?
Who has access to view these logs?
